sections.title: The Leap: From Geometry to Abstraction (0:00-0:45)
lecture_lines: Physical vectors are arrows in 2D or 3D space.
Vectors can be abstract objects, like functions or polynomials.
These objects must obey specific structural rules.
animations: Display a simple geometric point moving into a vector field #FF00FF.
Transform vector into an abstract dot on a coordinate plane #00FFFF.
Flash the dot to emphasize abstraction of location #FFFFFF.

sections.title: The Foundation: The Two Core Operations (0:45-1:45)
lecture_lines: A space needs two operations: Addition and Scalar Multiplication.
Addition combines vectors, like adding geometric arrows together.
Scalar multiplication scales vectors, changing their magnitude.
animations: Show two distinct vectors added visually as a tip-to-tail path #00FF00.
Show a vector being stretched by a scalar multiplier #FFFF00.
Highlight the resultant vector clearly in #FF0000.

sections.title: The Eight Axioms: The Rules of the Game (1:45-3:15)
lecture_lines: A Vector Space must satisfy eight core axioms.
Closure ensures results remain within the set.
Associativity and Commutativity dictate operational order.
The Zero vector acts as an additive identity.
Inverse elements allow for vector subtraction.
animations: Display the addition identity element as a null vector #FFFFFF.
Demonstrate additive inverse by animating vectors cancelling to origin #FF0000.
Visualize associative property by grouping vectors in different orders #00FFFF.

sections.title: Non-Example: Detecting Broken Spaces (3:15-4:15)
lecture_lines: Sets must include the zero vector to be spaces.
Closure under addition is vital for validity.
Failing these rules disqualifies the set from consideration.
animations: Show a path curve that fails the additive closure property #FF0000.
Highlight the gap where the scalar multiplication fails #FFFF00.
Flash the broken region to indicate lack of vector space structure #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Summary & Synthesis (4:15-5:00)
lecture_lines: Vector Spaces unify diverse mathematical structures.
We apply linear algebra tools across many fields.
Data science and quantum mechanics rely on these rules.
animations: Pan across all eight axioms summarized in a clean list #00FF00.
Display a checkmark icon next to valid operations #00FFFF.
Fade out the summary to prepare for final thoughts #FFFFFF.
